info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-Replace Banking Accounts Transfer-v3-spec
info.description: The Banking Accounts Transfer Management API facilitates seamless updates to existing banking account transfers. This API allows users to modify transfer details, ensuring accurate and timely financial transactions. It serves typical consumers such as banking institutions and financial service providers who require the ability to manage ongoing account transfers efficiently. By utilizing this API, developers can streamline the process of managing banking transfers and enhance their application's financial service offerings.

put.summary: Initiates a transfer of funds between accounts.
put.description: This operation allows users to transfer funds from one account to another. It requires account identifiers and the amount to be transferred. Ensure that both accounts are valid and that the source account has sufficient balance for the transfer.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a transfer between accounts. The payload should contain the necessary details regarding the accounts involved and the amount to be transferred.

200.description: Request completed successfully, and the transfer was processed.

requestId.description: A unique identifier for the request.

amount.description: The amount of money to transfer.

currency.description: The currency in which the transfer amount is specified.

notificationRequired.description: Indicates if notification is required after the transfer.

requestedAt.description: Timestamp when the transfer was requested.

channel.description: The channel through which the transfer request is made.

recordIndex.description: Index of the record in the records list.

ReplaceBankingAccountsTransferRequest.description: Schema representing the request body for transferring funds between accounts.
